news.titleEn: Nvidia interim CEO Kress says it's 'business as usual' at company: Live updates
news.conclusionEn: Nvidia's first report since Jensen Huang's resignation beat estimates, with revenue of $115.8 billion and guidance of about $130 billion for next quarter.
news.conclusionZh: 英伟达黄仁勋辞职后首份财报超预期，营收1158亿美元
news.whyEn: Nvidia is the bellwether for the whole AI trade; a strong beat under an interim CEO could stop a six-week slide that has dragged global tech stocks.
news.whyZh: 英伟达是AI行情风向标，超预期或止住其连续六周下跌，提振全球科技股
news.detailEn: Adjusted EPS was $2.68 versus $2.48 expected, data center revenue hit $107.6 billion and gross margin was 74.9%. Interim CEO Colette Kress raised the fiscal 2028 growth outlook to 75% from 70%, and shares rose about 3-4% after hours. The outlook still assumes zero data center revenue from China, where a new Commerce Department rule threatens chip rentals to Chinese firms. The board says it does not intend to bring Huang back, and the search for a permanent CEO continues.
news.detailZh: 调整后每股收益2.68美元，高于预期的2.48美元；数据中心营收1076亿美元，毛利率74.9%。临时CEO Colette Kress将2028财年增长预期从70%上调至75%，盘后股价涨约3%-4%。指引仍未计入任何来自中国的数据中心收入，美国商务部新规还可能禁止向中国企业出租芯片。董事会表示无意让黄仁勋回归，正式CEO仍在物色中。

news.titleEn: Dow drops more than 800 points, S&P 500 posts lowest close since July
news.conclusionEn: On Tuesday the Dow fell 848.75 points (1.64%) to 50,759.42 and the S&P 500 slid 1.03% to 7,340.53, its lowest close since late July.
news.conclusionZh: 道指周二跌849点，标普500创7月以来最低收盘
news.whyEn: A fourth straight losing day with the VIX near 28 shows investors are de-risking on several fronts at once, not just AI.
news.whyZh: 标普连跌四天、恐慌指数近28，说明资金在多方面同时避险，不只是AI
news.detailEn: Chip stocks were sold ahead of Nvidia's report, and a CNN report that a classified NSA network went down added to nerves; the NSA said it was temporary degradation during routine maintenance and CNN's sources saw no evidence of a cyberattack. Traders also cited a run of recent disruptions, including an FAA ground stop and a Microsoft Outlook outage. The Dow was down more than 1,000 points at its low and the Nasdaq touched its lowest level since April. Futures rebounded overnight after Nvidia's results.
news.detailZh: 芯片股在英伟达财报前遭抛售；CNN报道美国国安局一个机密网络宕机，进一步加剧紧张情绪，国安局称只是例行维护期间的暂时性性能下降，CNN消息人士也表示无网络攻击证据。交易员还提到近期一连串故障，包括美国联邦航空局全国停飞和微软Outlook宕机。道指盘中一度跌超1000点，纳指触及4月以来最低。英伟达财报公布后股指期货隔夜反弹。

news.titleEn: Treasury yields moderate as investors parse retail sales data
news.conclusionEn: With the 10-year Treasury yield near 5.11%, traders now price a 95% chance the Fed hikes rates by a quarter point in December.
news.conclusionZh: 美债10年期收益率约5.11%，市场押注12月加息概率达95%
news.whyEn: A shift from rate cuts to hikes raises borrowing costs worldwide and pressures stock valuations, mortgages and emerging-market currencies.
news.whyZh: 美联储从降息转向加息，将推高全球融资成本，压制股市估值和房贷
news.detailEn: October retail sales rose 0.2% to $748.2 billion, in line with forecasts, while sales excluding gas and autos rose 0.6%, beating the 0.4% estimate. St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem said the economy will likely need several rate increases before spring 2027, possibly up to four. The 2-year yield was around 4.81% and the 30-year about 5.46%. Minutes of the Fed's October meeting, when it held rates at 3.75%-4%, are due Wednesday.
news.detailZh: 美国10月零售销售增长0.2%至7482亿美元，符合预期；剔除汽油和汽车后增长0.6%，高于预期的0.4%。圣路易斯联储主席Musalem表示，2027年春季前经济可能需要多次加息，最多或达四次。2年期美债收益率约4.81%，30年期约5.46%。美联储10月会议维持利率在3.75%-4%不变，会议纪要将于周三公布。

news.titleEn: Anthropic likely to price IPO above the current range of $70 to $78, sources tell CNBC
news.conclusionEn: Anthropic's IPO is expected to price above its $70-$78 range, with Nasdaq trading under the ticker ANT slated to begin Nov. 19.
news.conclusionZh: Anthropic IPO定价料高于70-78美元区间，19日以ANT上市
news.whyEn: At up to $64 billion raised and a valuation above $1.4 trillion, it would be the largest IPO ever and a key test of investor appetite for AI.
news.whyZh: 募资或超640亿美元、估值超1.4万亿，将是史上最大IPO，检验AI投资热度
news.detailEn: Multiple sources told CNBC's David Faber that the order book closed Tuesday with demand supporting a price above the range; the final price had not been set. The original terms were 825 million shares, which at the top of the range would raise about $64.35 billion. Offshore pre-IPO contracts have implied a price near $98. The deal has also weighed on some software stocks, with investors rotating funds toward the AI listing.
news.detailZh: 多位知情人士向CNBC记者David Faber透露，订单簿周二截止，需求足以支撑高于区间的定价，但最终价格尚未确定。原定发行8.25亿股，按区间上限计算募资约643.5亿美元。海外上市前合约隐含的股价约为98美元。这笔发行也拖累了部分软件股，资金正转向这只AI新股。

news.titleEn: Iran launches a third round of strikes on Bahrain, host of U.S. Navy's 5th Fleet
news.conclusionEn: Iran's Revolutionary Guards struck a U.S. radar site in Bahrain for the third time in five days, and the U.S. hit back at Iran's Qeshm Island.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗五天内第三次袭击巴林美军目标，美军回击格什姆岛
news.whyEn: Repeated strikes on the host of the U.S. 5th Fleet threaten Qatar-mediated peace talks and keep Gulf shipping and oil supply at risk.
news.whyZh: 反复袭击美第五舰队驻地，威胁卡塔尔斡旋的和谈，海湾航运和油供风险持续
news.detailEn: Bahrain said it intercepted the drone attack on Sheikh Isa Air Base, and the U.S. reported no damage or casualties. Qatar warned the escalation is an extremely serious threat to reaching a deal, even as Iranian officials met Qatari mediators the same day. Egypt, Saudi Arabia and the UAE condemned the attack. Bahrain and Kuwait issued shelter warnings to civilians early on Nov. 18.
news.detailZh: 巴林称已拦截针对伊萨空军基地的无人机袭击，美方称无损失和人员伤亡。卡塔尔警告，局势升级对达成协议构成极其严重的威胁，而伊朗官员当天还在与卡塔尔调解人会面。埃及、沙特和阿联酋谴责了这次袭击。11月18日凌晨，巴林和科威特向民众发出避难警报。

news.titleEn: Iran escalates threats as third U.S. carrier arrives in Middle East, tanker struck in Hormuz
news.conclusionEn: A tanker caught fire after being hit in the Strait of Hormuz as a third U.S. carrier reached the Gulf, while Brent eased 0.7% to $91.8.
news.conclusionZh: 霍尔木兹海峡油轮遇袭起火，美第三艘航母抵达，布油跌至91.8美元
news.whyEn: Oil has fallen about 20% this month on peace hopes, but Hormuz attacks mean prices could swing sharply on any breakdown in talks.
news.whyZh: 油价本月因和谈希望已跌约两成，但海峡袭击意味着谈判一旦破裂油价或剧烈波动
news.detailEn: UK Maritime Trade Operations said an unidentified projectile struck a tanker, and Iran's navy claimed four tankers hit mines in the eastern strait over 24 hours. The USS Theodore Roosevelt joined two other U.S. carriers in the region. An Iranian army spokesperson said the strait would not reopen until Iran's conditions are accepted, and indirect U.S.-Iran talks via Qatar appear stalled. WTI fell 0.7% to $85.1 a barrel in Asian trading.
news.detailZh: 英国海事贸易行动办公室称一艘油轮被不明飞行物击中，伊朗海军还声称24小时内有四艘油轮在海峡东部触雷。美国「西奥多·罗斯福」号航母已与另外两艘航母会合。伊朗军方发言人表示，在伊朗条件被接受前海峡不会重新开放；经卡塔尔斡旋的美伊间接谈判似乎陷入停滞。亚洲交易时段WTI原油跌0.7%至每桶85.1美元。

news.titleEn: Trump en route to Asia ahead of meeting with Xi, Putin in China
news.conclusionEn: Trump is touring Asia ahead of a first-ever trilateral meeting with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen on Thursday during APEC.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普出访亚洲，周四将在深圳与习近平、普京首次三方会晤
news.whyEn: Nuclear arms control, the Iran war and Ukraine are on the table, and any signal could move oil, defense stocks and trade expectations.
news.whyZh: 议题涉及核军控、伊朗战争和乌克兰，任何信号都可能影响油价和贸易预期
news.detailEn: Trump first stops in the Philippines for a summit with Southeast Asian leaders, a Quad meeting and a trade deal with Thailand. The White House said nuclear disarmament, following the February expiry of New START, and the Iran war are on the agenda. Trump said he would raise Ukraine, contradicting officials, and Ukraine will have no representative. A senior U.S. official said no agreement is expected and called the meeting an entry point.
news.detailZh: 特朗普首站菲律宾，将出席东南亚领导人峰会、四方安全对话会议，并与泰国签署贸易协议。白宫表示，议题包括核裁军（《新削减战略武器条约》已于2月到期）和伊朗战争。特朗普称会谈及乌克兰问题，与其官员说法相矛盾，且乌克兰不会派代表出席。一名美国高级官员表示预计不会达成协议，称此次会晤只是一个「起点」。

news.titleEn: Investors lower tech stock exposure in biggest exit since 2006
news.conclusionEn: The net share of Bank of America fund-manager clients overweight tech fell 25 points in November, the biggest one-month drop since 2006.
news.conclusionZh: 美银调查：基金经理11月减持科技股幅度为2006年以来最大
news.whyEn: Big institutions rotating out of tech can extend the selloff, while ultra-low cash levels mean there is little dry powder to buy the dip.
news.whyZh: 机构撤出科技股可能延长跌势，而现金仓位极低，抄底资金有限
news.detailEn: Strategist Michael Hartnett said clients remain defensive and that there is not yet enough fear to justify buying the dip. Cash allocations sit at an uber-low 3.6%, and only about 12% of clients are still long the Magnificent Seven. The article ties the selloff to AI financing worries and the Nvidia scandal. Nvidia fell 24% in November before its earnings, and the S&P 500 tech sector lost more than 8%.
news.detailZh: 美银策略师Michael Hartnett表示，客户仍处于防御状态，目前市场恐慌程度还不足以支撑抄底。现金配置仅3.6%，处于「超低」水平，仅约12%的客户仍做多「七巨头」。文章将这轮抛售归因于AI融资担忧和英伟达丑闻。英伟达11月在财报前已累计下跌24%，标普500科技板块跌逾8%。

businessTips.explanationEn: A business continuity plan is a written playbook for keeping critical operations running when something breaks, such as a system outage, supplier failure or staff absence. It identifies which processes matter most, how long each can be down (recovery time objective) and what the backup procedure is. The value is that decisions are made calmly in advance instead of in a panic. This week's string of FAA, Microsoft and banking-app outages shows how often even large organisations get caught out.
businessTips.explanationZh: 业务连续性计划是一份书面预案，规定当系统宕机、供应商出问题或员工缺岗时，如何让关键业务继续运转。它要明确哪些流程最关键、每项最多能停多久（恢复时间目标），以及备用方案是什么。好处是提前冷静做决定，而不是出事时手忙脚乱。本周美国航空管制、微软和银行App接连故障，说明大机构也常被打个措手不及。
businessTips.exampleEn: A short-stay rental manager lists three critical processes: guest check-in codes, cleaner scheduling and payments. For each they write a fallback, such as a printed list of lock codes, a WhatsApp group if the scheduling app is down, and a second payment processor, then test it once a quarter.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位短租房管理者列出三项关键流程：住客入住密码、清洁排班和收款。每项都写好备用方案，比如打印一份门锁密码清单、排班App宕机时改用WhatsApp群、准备第二个收款渠道，并每季度演练一次。

businessTips.explanationEn: In Australia, a business or side hustle must register for GST once its annual GST turnover reaches A$75,000 (A$150,000 for non-profits); ride-share drivers must register from the first dollar. Once registered, you add 10% GST to taxable sales, lodge activity statements and can claim GST credits on business purchases. The test applies to both your current turnover and your projected turnover for the next 12 months, so fast-growing side hustles can cross it earlier than expected. Missing the deadline can mean paying GST out of your own pocket on past sales.
businessTips.explanationZh: 在澳大利亚，生意或副业的年GST营业额达到7.5万澳元（非营利组织为15万）就必须注册GST；网约车司机则从第一笔收入起就要注册。注册后，应税销售要加收10%的GST，定期提交营业活动报表，同时可以抵扣经营采购中包含的GST。门槛同时看当前营业额和未来12个月的预计营业额，增长快的副业可能比预想中更早触线。错过注册期限，可能要自掏腰包补缴过去销售的GST。
businessTips.exampleEn: A freelancer billing A$5,500 a month crosses the threshold within 14 months. Tracking rolling 12-month revenue in a spreadsheet lets them register on time and update pricing to GST-inclusive before the deadline, instead of losing 1/11 of every invoice.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位每月开票5500澳元的自由职业者，大约14个月就会触及门槛。用表格追踪滚动12个月收入，就能按时注册，并提前把报价调整为含GST，而不是让每张发票都白白损失1/11。

businessTips.explanationEn: Duration measures how sensitive a bond's price is to changes in interest rates, expressed roughly in years. As a rule of thumb, a bond with a duration of 7 loses about 7% of its value if yields rise by 1 percentage point, and gains about 7% if yields fall by the same amount. Longer-maturity and lower-coupon bonds have higher duration and therefore more rate risk. When markets expect the central bank to hike, short-duration holdings are usually less painful to own.
businessTips.explanationZh: 久期衡量债券价格对利率变动的敏感程度，大致以「年」为单位。经验法则是：久期为7的债券，收益率上升1个百分点，价格约跌7%；收益率下降同样幅度，价格约涨7%。期限越长、票息越低的债券，久期越大，利率风险也越高。当市场预期央行加息时，持有短久期资产通常损失更小。
businessTips.exampleEn: With traders pricing a 95% chance of a Fed hike in December, a long-term Treasury ETF with a duration near 17 could drop around 8% if 30-year yields climb another 0.5 point. A 1-3 year bond fund with a duration near 2 would lose only about 1% in the same move.
businessTips.exampleZh: 当前市场押注美联储12月加息的概率达95%。如果30年期收益率再升0.5个百分点，久期约17的长期美债ETF可能下跌约8%；而久期约2的1-3年期债券基金，同样情况下只会跌约1%。
